result.title: Differential rank preservation manifold learning
result.summary: Manifold learning methods like t-SNE and UMAP preserve local neighborhoods, but they do not preserve the ranking of the neighbors inside them. Two embeddings can return the same neighbor set while disagreeing on which point is closest. This loss of order degrades downstream applications that value the order in the embedding. We propose Smooth Rank t-SNE (SR-tSNE), which adds a differentiable rank term to the standard t-SNE loss. To enable efficient training, this term uses a sigmoid rank approximation to explicitly force a point's true high-dimensional neighbors to outrank unrelated intruders and retain their original order. We also introduce Ordinal DLP (O-DLP), an extension of the Degree of Locality Preservation (DLP) metric that credits a neighbor only when it returns at its original rank. Across eight benchmarks spanning image, text, speech, remote-sensing and single-cell data, SR-tSNE outperforms 12 baselines in rank preservation and neighborhood overlap. Ablation studies demonstrate our rank term alone boosts O-DLP by 5% to 28%, a gain not achievable using standard pairwise loss. This advantage transfers to downstream applications. SR-tSNE achieves the best label-transfer performance across seven vision datasets. For cell-type discovery across six single-cell datasets, it ranks first in 17 of 18 dataset-metric combinations, whether clustering resolution is selected with or without cell-type labels. In intraday trading, SR-tSNE achieves higher returns, lower risk, and lower turnover than the baselines. To our knowledge, SR-tSNE is the first t-SNE-family method with explicit order preservation.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作指出 t-SNE、UMAP 等流形学习只保留近邻集合而丢失近邻排序，提出在 t-SNE 损失中加入基于 sigmoid 秩近似的可微排序项（SR-tSNE），并提出只在近邻回到原始名次时才计分的 O-DLP 指标，在八个基准及标签迁移、细胞类型发现、交易等下游任务上验证排序保持的收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「近邻集合一致但排序不一致」的观察与排序保持指标，可能可供核查 latent 表示中细粒度视觉相似结构是否被保留；但研究对象是通用降维与嵌入可视化，与 VLM 推理状态生成无直接关系，迁移价值需进一步判断。
